raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stacked on #44312 (`priority` and the `x-override-*` headers on the Rust frontend): this branch is based on `oss-sync-fc133deaf0`, and the diff against it is this change alone. Once #44312 merges, this will be rebased onto `main`.

## Motivation

The Rust frontend's `/generate` schema ignores unknown top-level keys, so request fields the Python server honours are dropped silently in Rust mode. Four of them change the result:

- `cache_salt`: the prefix cache's second namespace key, beside `extra_key`. Dropping it lets requests sent under different salts share cached prefixes.
- `require_reasoning`: the scheduler applies grammar constraints only after the reasoning section. Dropping it constrains the reasoning output from the first token.
- `lora_path` and `session_params`: dropping them returns base-model or stateless output with a 200. Python returns a 400 for both on a server without LoRA or without that session.

## Modifications

- `cache_salt` and `require_reasoning` become `GenerateRequest` schema fields (proto tags 25 and 26; `api_types.py`, `sglang.api.v1.rs` and `sglang.api.v1.serde.rs` regenerated with `cargo gen-api`). `cache_salt` follows Python's `_normalize_cache_salt`, the same rules as `extra_key`: one value broadcasts, a list is per item and needs a batch of the same length, and an empty value means none (`message/request.rs`). Both reach the scheduler header, whose default slots are now filled through `cache_salt`, slot 45, so the header is 46 entries long (`message/io_struct.rs`).
- `lora_path` and `session_params` are declared as raw JSON fields (tags 27 and 28) so that a non-null value is a 400 ("… is not supported by the Rust server"). `null` still passes, so the `bench_serving` payload parses as before.
- The four fields leave the pinned list of Python-only request fields in `test_parity.py`. The rest of that list (`custom_labels`, `log_metrics`, `no_logs`, …) stays ignored; dropping those changes only logging.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: the change only affects which request fields the Rust frontend forwards to the scheduler, not the generated tokens.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Test plan

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo gen-api` reproduces the checked-in generated files byte for byte.
- `cargo test --locked -p sglang-server -p sglang-api-types`: 330 + 20 passed, 0 failed. The changed tests:
  - `cache_keys_fan_out` (was `extra_key_fans_out`) covers `cache_salt` broadcast, per item, empty, and a list on a single request (400), plus `require_reasoning` reaching every item;
  - `unported_generate_req_input_fields_are_ignored` checks that `lora_path` and `session_params` pass as `null` and are a 400 otherwise;
  - the header alignment tests assert `require_reasoning` at slot 33, the default slots 36–44 and `cache_salt` at 45, with length 46.
- `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_parity.py` and `test/registered/unit/api/v1/test_json_contract.py`: 33 passed, 21 subtests.
- Not run here: an end-to-end Rust-mode server; the request path past `into_requests` is unchanged.

files.patch:
@@ -259,6 +259,10 @@ class GenerateRequest(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True, frozen=True):
     audio_data: Optional[MediaInput] = None
     extra_key: Optional[StringOrList] = None
     priority: Optional[int] = None
+    cache_salt: Optional[StringOrList] = None
+    require_reasoning: Optional[bool] = None
+    lora_path: Optional[Any] = None
+    session_params: Optional[Any] = None
 
     @classmethod
     def from_json_value(cls, value: Any) -> "GenerateRequest":
@@ -1102,6 +1106,14 @@ def decode_GenerateRequest(value: Any) -> GenerateRequest:
             kw["extra_key"] = None if x is None else decode_StringOrList(x)
         elif key == "priority":
             kw["priority"] = None if x is None else _expect_int(x, expected="i64")
+        elif key == "cache_salt":
+            kw["cache_salt"] = None if x is None else decode_StringOrList(x)
+        elif key == "require_reasoning":
+            kw["require_reasoning"] = None if x is None else _expect_bool(x, expected="a boolean")
+        elif key == "lora_path":
+            kw["lora_path"] = x
+        elif key == "session_params":
+            kw["session_params"] = x
     return GenerateRequest(**kw)
 
 
@@ -1155,6 +1167,14 @@ def encode_GenerateRequest(v: GenerateRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
         d["extra_key"] = encode_StringOrList(v.extra_key)
     if v.priority is not None:
         d["priority"] = v.priority
+    if v.cache_salt is not None:
+        d["cache_salt"] = encode_StringOrList(v.cache_salt)
+    if v.require_reasoning is not None:
+        d["require_reasoning"] = v.require_reasoning
+    if v.lora_path is not None:
+        d["lora_path"] = v.lora_path
+    if v.session_params is not None:
+        d["session_params"] = v.session_params
     return d

@@ -383,6 +383,22 @@ pub struct GenerateRequest {
     /// validates it against its priority-scheduling mode.
     #[prost(int64, optional, tag = "24")]
     pub priority: ::core::option::Option<i64>,
+    /// Prefix-cache salt: a second namespace beside `extra_key`, normalized the
+    /// same way.
+    #[prost(message, optional, tag = "25")]
+    pub cache_salt: ::core::option::Option<StringOrList>,
+    /// Apply grammar constraints only after the reasoning section, for every
+    /// batch item.
+    #[prost(bool, optional, tag = "26")]
+    pub require_reasoning: ::core::option::Option<bool>,
+    /// Fields this server cannot honour. Unknown keys are ignored, but
+    /// dropping these would silently change the result (base-model output for a
+    /// LoRA request, a stateless answer for a session request), so a non-null
+    /// value is rejected instead.
+    #[prost(string, optional, tag = "27")]
+    pub lora_path: ::core::option::Option<::prost::alloc::string::String>,
+    #[prost(string, optional, tag = "28")]
+    pub session_params: ::core::option::Option<::prost::alloc::string::String>,
 }
 #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, ::prost::Message)]
 pub struct SamplingParamsOrList {
